excluded.reason: Copyrighted 1960, renewed 1988 by Sociedades Biblicas Unidas, and a registered trademark. The rights holder names mobile applications and websites as requiring written permission. Never distributable without a licence.

Robinson's Morphological Analysis Codes as distributed by CrossWire are CC BY-SA 3.0. The share-alike obligation propagates to derived data, which would taint every catalog it entered. The underlying coding scheme is a fact, but the distributed file is a 2002 copyrighted compilation.

The Open Scriptures Strong's dictionary data file is GPL-3.0 — a copyleft software licence applied to data. Using it in a closed app would arguably trigger GPL obligations. Strong's 1890 is public domain and is re-derived from the archival scan instead.
Robertson's Word Pictures volumes 5 and 6 were published in 1932/1933 and renewed in 1960. Under the 95-years-from-publication rule they are not US public domain until 2028 and 2029 respectively.

Vine's Expository Dictionary (1940) is genuinely contested: probably public domain by 2026, but with no authoritative statement confirming non-renewal and an unresolved public debate. Excluded pending legal confirmation.
The common modern edition of the Scofield Reference Notes carries substantive 1970s additions by Palmore/Royalston and is copyrighted, despite the 1917 original being old.

The Spanish Matthew Henry in circulation is Francisco Lacueva's CLIE translation (1983), a modern copyrighted work. Biblioteca de Autores Cristianos republishes ancient authors in modern copyrighted translations. There is no public-domain Spanish commentary available.
Tyndale House STEP Bible publishes its own datasets under CC BY-NC 3.0, which forbids commercial use.
Liddell & Scott & Jones, 9th edition (1940) is in copyright; the Perseus electronic edition is CC BY-SA.

license.basis: Explicitly dedicated to the public domain by its editor. Trademark on the name is disclaimed in the attribution.

license.attribution: King James Version, public domain by age. Cross-references: Treasury of Scripture Knowledge (public domain), redistributed by CrossReferences.org under CC BY 4.0.
license.basis: Published 1611/1769; public domain by age in every life+70 jurisdiction and pre-1931 in the US. Note the ABS KJV concordance is separately copyrighted; only the Bible text is used here.

license.attribution: John Calvin, Commentaries, Calvin Translation Society translation (Edinburgh, 1843-1857).
license.basis: Published 1843-1857, pre-1931 in the US; every named translator died in the 19th century, so life+70 has expired. Covers the same 48 books Calvin actually wrote on.

license.attribution: C. F. Keil and F. Delitzsch, Commentary on the Old Testament, translated by James Martin (1864-1891).
license.basis: Published 1864-1891; Keil d.1888, Delitzsch d.1890, life+70 long expired. Last great Old Critical commentary before Wellhausen.

modules.name: Keil and Delitzsch on the Old Testament

license.attribution: Albert Barnes, Notes on the Bible (1832-1834). New Testament only.
license.basis: Published 1832-1834; Barnes d.1870, life+70 expired. Genuinely exegetical-analytical. The SWORD module is chapter-blocked, so verse notes are recovered by splitting the inline verse markers.

modules.name: Barnes' Notes on the New Testament

license.attribution: Adam Clarke, Commentary on the Old and New Testaments (1831-1834).
license.basis: Published 1831-1834; Clarke d.1832. Carries a real critical apparatus with variant readings and the original languages. Doctrinal notes are Wesleyan and are flagged as such in the UI.

modules.name: Adam Clarke's Commentary on the Bible

license.attribution: Robert Jamieson, A. R. Fausset and David Brown, Commentary Critical and Explanatory (1871-1878).
license.basis: Published 1871-1878; all three authors pre-1931. Authorship is uneven — Fausset wrote 44 of the books and is the strongest; Brown is the weakest.

Published 1890; Strong d.1894, life+70 expired in 1965, and pre-1931 in the US. Re-derived from the 1890 scan. The Open Scriptures Strong's data file is GPL-3.0 and is deliberately NOT used; the ABS KJV Concordance is separately copyrighted and is also not used.

license.attribution: Joseph Henry Thayer, A Greek-English Lexicon of the New Testament (Harper, 1889).
license.basis: Title page reads copyright 1886/1889; well inside the PD window for both the US and life+70 Spain. The abridged edition published by Larry Pierce is separately copyrighted and is not used.

license.attribution: Francis Brown, S. R. Driver and Samuel Rolles Briggs, A Hebrew and English Lexicon of the Old Testament (Clarendon, 1906).
license.basis: Published 1906; pre-1931 in the US and all authors long deceased. The abridged edition published by Larry Pierce is separately copyrighted and is not used.
Original copyrights 1896 and 1897; public domain by age.
Compiled around 1830, public domain by age. The bare 1830 text is used; online editions that append Nelson's illustrated notes are separately copyrighted and are not used.
The Masoretic text is ancient; the 1904/1908 editions are public domain by age. The text is PD; only downstream tagging carries a licence.

license.attribution: Biblia Platense (Straubinger), La Plata, 1948. Public domain in Chile, Spain and the EU from 2027-01-01.
license.basis: Juan Straubinger (1883-1956). Life+70 under Ley 17.336 art. 10 (Chile), Spain and the EU expires 2026-12-31, so the work enters the public domain on 2027-01-01. NOT public domain in the United States, where the 95-years-from-publication rule for works of 1931-1977 runs to 2043. Open question: Straubinger consulted Nácar-Colunga (1944) and Bóver-Cantera (1947); the stated base text is the Masoretic text, but verbatim borrowing would pull in rights lasting to 2031 (Prado) and 2053 (Cantera). Textual verification is required before distribution.
Published 1865; public domain by age in every life+70 jurisdiction.
Published 1899; public domain by age. Pairs with the Biblia Platense to cover the Catholic canon, including the deuterocanonicals, in English.

note: Every entry is validated by tool/validate_catalog.dart. The Biblia Platense is present with a release date of 2027-01-01; builds before that date are blocked by the gate rather than silently shipping it.
